paper.title: Joint optimization of wind farm layout considering optimal control
paper.authors: Kaixuan Chen and Jin Lin and Yiwei Qiu and Feng Liu and Yonghua Song

public_asset_candidate_evidence.status: target arXiv TeX and figures plus cited FLORISSE_M inspected; no target DBHM executable or result archive found

paper_source_conflicts: Eq.1 prints a positive Gaussian exponent instead of the physically required negative exponent.
Eq.8 includes i=j and is infeasible for any positive minimum distance.
Eq.15 includes self-pairs and double-counts unordered pair penalties.
Eq.3 has dimensionally ambiguous empirical scaling relative to the cited FLORISSE_M formulation.
The broad nonconvex-ADMM convergence paragraph does not state all assumptions needed for an unconditional certificate.
The scenario subproblem is described as 4N-dimensional although the auxiliary epsilon variable is also written.
missing_information: target DBHM/MATLAB source, exact FLORISSE_M adaptation, optimizer options, random states, seeds, traces and result archive
numeric 36-sector wind rose and exact 16/80-turbine coordinates
PSO population, coefficients, iteration budget and termination
interior-point implementation, rotor quadrature, x0, turbulence intensity and near-wake handling
all final layouts, controls and consensus histories
completion_decisions: Restore the negative Gaussian exponent and unique unordered turbine-pair constraints and penalties.
Retain the printed two-dimensional Eq.3 as an explicitly declared paper-literal adaptation because target source is absent.
Use the pinned FLORISSE_M x0 relationship and infer ambient turbulence from paper ky=0.0229 and source ka/kb.
Use nine deterministic lateral rotor samples and root-sum-square wake deficits.
Digitize and normalize the original arXiv 36-sector wind rose; aggregate or subdivide it for 12/180/360 directions.

Reconstruct the 16-turbine 1900x1700m grid and 80-turbine Horns-Rev 10x8 parallelogram from the paper text and figures; treat 7D as the Horns initial lattice side and retain 4D as the minimum feasible separation.
Retain ten PSO trials and declare population40, 30 iterations and standard Clerc coefficients for absent settings.
Use a bounded projected pattern solver for the unspecified MATLAB interior-point routine.
Preserve DBHM scenario decomposition, analytic coordination, mu10, multiplier update and consensus tolerance10 with at most12 declared iterations.
Use one persistent full-core executor for complete PSO individuals and independent wind-scenario control/DBHM subproblems; this directly realizes the paper's explicit parallelization opportunity.

scope.claim_boundary: source-backed flexible academic reconstruction of the target joint layout-control problem, DBHM and all paper-native profiles and roles; not author code, exact MATLAB/FLORISSE-M adaptation, private arrays, trajectories or numerical replay

decision_variables.resolution: continuous two-dimensional layout plus per-turbine yaw and axial induction for each wind scenario

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: canonical coordinate vectors and scenario-indexed control vectors

constraints_and_repair.resolution: rectangular bounds, corrected i<j Euclidean 4D separation and deterministic projection repair; 7D is only the Horns initial lattice side

objective_and_direction.resolution: maximize probability-weighted annual energy through isolated, sequential and joint-control roles

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: corrected-sign Gaussian yaw/induction wake, fixed rotor sampling, RSS superposition and actuator-disk power

wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: normalized 36-sector digitization with explicit 12-bin aggregation and 180/360-bin subdivision

paper_native_cases.resolution: two three-turbine illustrations and four 16/80-turbine direction profiles with all Cases1-5

initialization.resolution: paper-figure initial layouts and ten counter-keyed PSO trials

parameters.resolution: paper physical/control/DBHM parameters plus population40, PSO30, control5 and DBHM12

update_order.resolution: PSO warm start, scenario controls, frozen local subproblems, ordered consensus and multiplier update

stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: PSO30, control5 and DBHM convergence below10m or maximum12; complete layout and single-wind state evaluations both recorded

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: all paper AEP anchors, five roles, efficiency, spacing, consensus, physical work, timing, workers and hash; one formal run per profile

training_and_inference_lifecycle.resolution: PSO and DBHM have no trained model

development_h6_20260801.comparison_boundary: same final pure-C++ implementation with one versus twenty Spark workers; not MATLAB, author code or Waffle confirmation
